q: What do you know about the role of a cabin crew member?
a:
A cabin crew member is responsible for ensuring the safety, comfort, and well-being of passengers during the flight. Some of the main responsibilities are conducting safety checks, explaining safety procedures, responding to emergencies, and providing excellent customer service.

They must stay calm under pressure or in unexpected situations, communicate clearly, and show empathy to handle difficult situations effectively.

Cabin crew also work closely as a team to create a smooth and enjoyable experience from boarding to landing.

Overall, the role is about being the face of the airline while maintaining high standards of safety and hospitality.
